evidence.claim: 라파르그는 게드·드빌과 함께 새로 창당한 프랑스 노동자당(POF)의 활동을 지도했다.
evidence.excerpt: Together with Jules Guesde and Gabriel Deville, he began directing the activities of the newly initiated French Workers' Party (Parti Ouvrier Français; POF), which he caused to conflict with other major left-wing trends: anarchism, as well as the Jacobin Radicals and Blanquists.

evidence.claim: 카베는 이카리아 운동을 창시한 공상적 사회주의자였다.
evidence.excerpt: Étienne Cabet (French: [etjɛn kabɛ]; January 1, 1788 – November 9, 1856) was a philosopher and utopian socialist who founded the Icarian movement.

evidence.claim: 카베는 텍사스와 일리노이에 이카리아 공동체를 세웠다.
evidence.excerpt: Cabet founded utopian communities in Texas and Illinois, but was again undercut, this time by recurring feuds with his followers.
